description: This file is a C header defining the interface for commit objects in a version control system, likely Git. It includes struct definitions, function declarations for commit lookup, parsing, signing, verification, and management, as well as constants and macros related to commits.

classes.name: commit_list
classes.description: A linked list structure holding commit objects.

classes.name: commit
classes.description: Represents a commit object with metadata such as date, parents, and associated tree.

classes.name: name_decoration
classes.description: Associates a name decoration with objects for display or reference.

classes.name: commit_graft
classes.description: Represents graft information for commits, including parent relationships.

classes.name: commit_extra_header
classes.description: Represents extra headers in commit messages, such as signatures or merge info.

methods.name: add_name_decoration
methods.description: Associates a name decoration with an object.

methods.name: get_name_decoration
methods.description: Retrieves name decorations associated with an object.

methods.name: lookup_commit_object
methods.description: Looks up a commit object by object ID, respecting replacement objects.

methods.name: lookup_commit
methods.description: Looks up a commit by object ID without replacement checks.

methods.name: lookup_commit_reference
methods.description: Looks up a commit by object ID with specific referencing rules.

methods.name: lookup_commit_reference_gently
methods.description: Gently looks up a commit by object ID, returning NULL if not found.

methods.name: lookup_commit_reference_by_name
methods.description: Looks up a commit by name or reference string.

methods.name: lookup_commit_reference_by_name_gently
methods.description: Gently looks up a commit by name.

methods.name: lookup_commit_or_die
methods.description: Looks up a commit by object ID, dies if not found or not a commit.

methods.name: parse_commit_buffer
methods.description: Parses a commit buffer into a commit object.

methods.name: repo_parse_commit_internal
methods.description: Internal function to parse commit data with options.

methods.name: repo_parse_commit_gently
methods.description: Gentle parsing of commit data.

methods.name: int repo_parse_commit(struct repository * r,struct commit * item)
methods.description: Default parse commit wrapper.

methods.name: int repo_parse_commit_no_graph(struct repository * r,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Parse commit data without the commit graph.

methods.name: parse_commit_or_die
methods.description: Parse commit or die trying.

methods.name: unparse_commit
methods.description: Serializes a commit object back into a buffer.

methods.name: allocate_commit_buffer_slab
methods.description: Allocates a buffer slab for commit buffers.

methods.name: free_commit_buffer_slab
methods.description: Frees a commit buffer slab.

methods.name: set_commit_buffer
methods.description: Associates a buffer with a commit, transferring ownership.

methods.name: get_cached_commit_buffer
methods.description: Retrieves cached buffer for a commit, if any.

methods.name: repo_get_commit_buffer
methods.description: Gets commit buffer data, reading from disk if necessary.

methods.name: repo_unuse_commit_buffer
methods.description: Releases a commit buffer when done.

methods.name: free_commit_buffer
methods.description: Frees cached commit buffer.

methods.name: repo_get_commit_tree
methods.description: Retrieves the tree associated with a commit.

methods.name: get_commit_tree_oid
methods.description: Gets the object ID of the commit's tree.

methods.name: release_commit_memory
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a commit.

methods.name: detach_commit_buffer
methods.description: Disassociates buffer from commit without freeing it.

methods.name: find_commit_subject
methods.description: Finds the subject part of a commit message.

methods.name: commit_subject_length
methods.description: Returns length of commit subject.

methods.name: commit_list_insert
methods.description: Inserts a commit into a list.

methods.name: commit_list_contains
methods.description: Checks if a list contains a commit.

methods.name: commit_list_append
methods.description: Appends a commit to a list.

methods.name: commit_list_count
methods.description: Counts commits in a list.

methods.name: commit_list_insert_by_date
methods.description: Inserts commit into list sorted by date.

methods.name: commit_list_sort_by_date
methods.description: Sorts list by commit date.

methods.name: copy_commit_list
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of a commit list.

methods.name: reverse_commit_list
methods.description: Reverses a commit list.

methods.name: free_commit_list
methods.description: Frees a commit list.

methods.name: repo_logmsg_reencode
methods.description: Re-encodes a commit message for logs.

methods.name: skip_blank_lines
methods.description: Skips blank lines in a message buffer.

methods.name: pop_most_recent_commit
methods.description: Removes the most recent commit from a priority queue.

methods.name: pop_commit
methods.description: Pops the top commit from a stack.

methods.name: clear_commit_marks
methods.description: Clears a mark on a commit.

methods.name: clear_commit_marks_many
methods.description: Clears a mark on many commits.

methods.name: sort_in_topological_order
methods.description: Sorts commits topologically.

methods.name: read_graft_line
methods.description: Reads a graft line into a commit_graft structure.

methods.name: commit_graft_pos
methods.description: Returns position of graft for a commit.

methods.name: register_commit_graft
methods.description: Registers a commit graft.

methods.name: prepare_commit_graft
methods.description: Prepares graft data for repository.

methods.name: lookup_commit_graft
methods.description: Looks up graft info for a commit.

methods.name: get_fork_point
methods.description: Finds the fork point for a commit.

methods.name: for_each_commit_graft
methods.description: Iterates over all commit grafts.

methods.name: interactive_add
methods.description: Performs interactive add operation.

methods.name: append_merge_tag_headers
methods.description: Appends headers for merge tags.

methods.name: commit_tree
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified message, tree, and parents.

methods.name: commit_tree_extended
methods.description: Creates a new commit with extended options.

methods.name: read_commit_extra_headers
methods.description: Reads extra headers from a commit object.

methods.name: free_commit_extra_headers
methods.description: Frees commit extra headers list.

methods.name: find_commit_header
methods.description: Finds a specific header in commit message.

methods.name: ignored_log_message_bytes
methods.description: Calculates bytes to ignore in log message tail.

methods.name: for_each_mergetag
methods.description: Iterates over mergetags in a commit.

methods.name: merge_remote_util
methods.description: Obtains remote info for merge.

methods.name: set_merge_remote_desc
methods.description: Associates remote description with a commit.

methods.name: get_merge_parent
methods.description: Gets merge parent commit based on name.

methods.name: parse_signed_commit
methods.description: Parses a signed commit's content.

methods.name: remove_signature
methods.description: Removes signature from commit buffer.

methods.name: check_commit_signature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a commit.

methods.name: verify_commit_buffer
methods.description: Verifies signature over commit buffer.

methods.name: record_author_date
methods.description: Records author date metadata.

methods.name: compare_commits_by_author_date
methods.description: Comparator for author date.

methods.name: verify_merge_signature
methods.description: Verifies signatures for merge commits.

methods.name: compare_commits_by_commit_date
methods.description: Comparator for commit date.

methods.name: compare_commits_by_gen_then_commit_date
methods.description: Comparator for generation and commit date.

methods.name: run_commit_hook
methods.description: Runs a hook script during commit process.

methods.name: sign_with_header
methods.description: Signs a buffer with a key.

methods.name: parse_buffer_signed_by_header
methods.description: Parses signed data from header.

methods.name: add_header_signature
methods.description: Adds a signature to a header buffer.
